title: UAAP: Roberts, Bahay power Ateneo past Adamson for bounce-back win
summary: Ateneo de Manila University returned to the win column after taking down Adamson University in UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball on Saturday at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City.
